clips.title: The story
paras: Taming the Beast is a hunter training lesson overseen by Josephine Carson. After learning the fundamentals of beast handling with a boar, the aspiring hunter must use a Taming Rod to earn the trust of a fiercer Gray Forest Wolf.

A hunter's connection with the wild requires more than mere tracking and marksmanship; it demands the respect and patience needed to earn a wild creature's trust. After proving their foundational skills on simple boars, aspiring hunters are presented with a far fiercer challenge: venturing into the forest to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Under the watchful eye of trainer Josephine Carson, the hunter is entrusted with an enchanted rod to calm the predator and learn the delicate balance between hunter and beast.

Josephine Carson provides the hunter with a specialized Taming Rod, designed to channel a calming influence that allows the hunter to approach dangerous wildlife. The task requires patience and precision, as the wolf must be approached without lethal force while its natural aggression is gently overcome. Once the bond is practiced and the hunter proves capable of harmonizing with the beast's spirit, the rod is returned to Josephine as proof of growing mastery over the wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.
Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as an adventurer once more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! You're quite in tune with the beast.
